notes.title: "DREAM HOTEL MASTER" Launching on May 8th with a 20% Launch Discount!
notes.notes:
Get ready for the grand opening of "DREAM HOTEL MASTER" on May 8th! Dive into the world of hotel management and design your dream hotel empire. Enjoy a special 20% launch discount exclusively on Steam! Don't miss out on this opportunity to become a hotel tycoon!
